mintAuthority.summary: EURR canonical issuance is verified on Ethereum. The owner-controlled mint path remains direct and unbounded, with the May 2026 unauthorized issuance and continued mint/redeem suspension preserved as adverse evidence; the separately listed Solana deployment is unresolved and is not counted as native Mint Authority.

mintIncidents.summary: A compromised StablR mint/governance key let the attacker mint 4.5M unbacked EURR as part of a coordinated USDR/EURR attack, leaving both tokens undercollateralized and forcing mint/redeem suspension.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770841 on 2026-08-16, owner() returned the 2-of-3 custom multisig 0x05Aa2D11B1148a3732ab68451a491FD544a0FbBD and the EIP-1967 admin slot returned 0xA0609c2F05A386D835ae3C01CDA296a5F63878a0; the implementation slot returned 0x76e0baef381656d51d733cf9aa60d7bf8017f958. The May 2026 unauthorized issuance and the 24 June update confirming continued mint/redeem suspension remain adverse evidence. Grant Thornton quarterly proof of reserve provides periodic reconciliation and MFSA EMI authorization provides prudential supervision. The Solana SPL mint HViRSvsTpwubWHevjSPxNB22Fg3kdzXtedfQXmMoHtoZ had supply 0 at finalized slot 439735039; mint authority aNk7d9zZhAgVw8EuGzV15vgMKmjnbHCxtnozeJb51ij and freeze authority AtgugpVoTQcjxjtWgECnSfyThJxBVggSS8WfzVCXNDmV were system-program-owned, non-executable wallets at finalized slot 439735091, but the issuer has not established whether Solana creates independent liabilities or mirrors Ethereum supply. Solana is therefore retained as an unresolved evidence gap and is not compiled as native Mint Authority.
